verdict.rationale: A runtime npm probe confirms @babylonjs/core 9.26.1 is published under the Apache-2.0 open-source license, so its distributed code is readable. The official llms.txt also describes Babylon.js as an 'open' game and rendering engine. Missing for 10: evidence of a public source repository (e.g. GitHub) with the original TypeScript sources, first-party licensing documentation, and independent community corroboration of source access.
